props.name: align
props.description:
Active-item alignment when the viewport is wider than an item: `'start'`
(default) | `'center'` | `'end'`. Requires `containerWidth`.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Auto-advance through items on an interval. Pauses while dragging.

props.name: axisLock
props.description:
Only consume gestures that are predominantly horizontal (±45°); a vertical
drag is released to the host scroll surface. Mirrors lynx-ui's
`experimentalHorizontalSwipeOnly`.

props.name: circular
props.description: Alias for `loop` — matches lynx-ui's `circular` naming. `loop` wins.

props.name: containerWidth
props.description: Viewport width, px — needed for `align: center/end` and the end clamp.

props.name: interval
props.description: Autoplay step interval in ms (time an item is shown before advancing).

props.name: loop
props.description:
Navigate circularly: dragging/autoplay past the last item wraps to the
first SEAMLESSLY — edge slides are cloned so motion continues across the
seam. When false, the track clamps at the ends.

props.name: mode
props.description:
Layout mode. `'normal'` (default) is the standard paged carousel;
`'carousel'` is a forward-compat alias treated as normal.

props.name: offsetLimit
props.description:
Explicit `[startLimit, endLimit]` non-loop offset clamp, px past each edge
the track may rest. Mirrors lynx-ui `offsetLimit`.

props.name: rtl
props.description: Right-to-left layout. A forward swipe moves visually rightward.

props.name: spaceBetween
props.description:
Gap between adjacent items, px — the snap unit becomes
`itemWidth + spaceBetween`. Mirrors lynx-ui `modeConfig.spaceBetween`.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the snap unit dragged past which the snap rounds up.

props.name: velocityThreshold
props.description: px/s flick above which a release advances by one item.
